findings.title: immediateDelete cancels SendGrid but never deletes DB row
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder with immediateDelete=true (used for reschedule in handleNewBooking.ts and for workflow/step delete in workflows.tsx) POSTs batch cancel to SendGrid and then returns without deleting or updating the workflowReminder row. The row stays with scheduled=true and the old referenceId. For reschedule there is no cascade delete, so orphan rows accumulate, are never marked cancelled for the cron to pick up, and past-date cleanup is the only eventual removal. Fix must delete the reminder row after successful SendGrid cancel.

findings.title: One SendGrid failure aborts all pending email cancellations
findings.body: The cron wraps the entire for-loop of SendGrid cancel calls and the Prisma deletes in a single try/catch. If client.request throws for any one reminder, the loop aborts, remaining reminders are never attempted, and the workflowRemindersToDelete array built so far is never awaited because Promise.all is skipped on exception. One bad batch_id therefore leaves all other cancelled emails scheduled and they will still be sent. Handle each reminder independently.

findings.title: Cancel query too broad and past-cancelled rows deleted without SendGrid cancel
findings.body: remindersToCancel filters only on cancelled:true and scheduledDate, with no method=EMAIL, scheduled=true, or referenceId-not-null filter, so it can attempt SendGrid cancel with batch_id null and fail the whole batch. Worse, the earlier deleteMany at line 34 deletes all EMAIL reminders with scheduledDate in the past, including cancelled ones, without calling SendGrid. Those rows disappear from the cancel query so their scheduled sends are never cancelled. Filter the cancel query and run cancels before blind past-date deletes.

findings.title: Paid bookings return before workflow reminders are cancelled
findings.body: When booking.paid is true the handler refunds, updates status to REJECTED, awaits apiDeletes and returns at line 464. The workflow-reminder cancellation loop at lines 485-493 is below that return and never runs for this path. Paid cancelled bookings therefore keep their scheduled email/SMS workflowReminders and the reminders are still sent. Move reminder cancellation before the paid early-return or duplicate it there.

findings.title: Async reminder cancellations fired without await
findings.body: updatedBookings.forEach calls deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder, both async functions doing Prisma updates and SendGrid/Twilio calls, without awaiting or collecting promises. The same fire-and-forget forEach pattern is repeated in handleNewBooking.ts reschedule, bookings.tsx requestReschedule, and workflows.tsx. The request can finish and return success before the cancelled flag is persisted, errors are swallowed, and try/catch around forEach cannot catch them. Await with Promise.all.
